questions.question:
Three Statements are given followed by Four conclusions numbered I, II, III and IV. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some chairs are holders.

Some holders are bottles.

Some bottles are chairs.

**Conclusions:**

I. All chairs are bottles.

II. All bottles are chairs.

III. All holders are bottles.

IV. All holders are chairs.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Both conclusions III and IV follow.
Both conclusions II and III follow.

questions.solution:
Given:

Some chairs are holders.

Some holders are bottles.

Some bottles are chairs.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94bb73cdd68251a7466af74b86a764ce779f1da6d6abf05d718f18507f12e899.png] 

**Conclusions: **

I. All chairs are bottles - False (Because, some chairs are bottles. so, all chairs are bottles can be possible only).

II. All bottles are chairs - False (Because, some bottles are chairs. so, All bottles are chairs can be possible only).

III. All holders are bottles - False (Because, some bottles are holders. so, All holders are bottles can be possible only).

IV. All holders are chairs - False (Because, some chairs are holders. so, All holders are chairs can be possible only).

Thus, None of the conclusions follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**

questions.question: 14th Feb 2022 was Monday. What day of the week on was 14th Feb 2020?
questions.solution:
Given: 14th Feb 2022 was Monday.

Now, 2020 to 2022 = 2 Years.

In 2 years, 1 Leap year and 1 ordinary years.

Total odd days from 14th Feb 2020 to 14th Feb 2022 = (1 × 2) + (1 × 1) = 2 + 1 = 3 days.

So, 14th Feb 2020 was = Monday - 3 = **Friday**.

Hence, the correct option is "Option 1".

In Row 2 – P, Q, R, S and T are seated and all of them are facing the north.

Who is facing E?
questions.solution:

questions.question:
If '+' means '÷', ‘-' means '+', '×' means ‘-', '÷' means '×', then what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation? 

49 - 6 ÷ 4 + 2 × 14 = ?
questions.solution:
Given Equation: 49 - 6 ÷ 4 + 2 × 14 = ?

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png] 

Decoding the given information:

 
 

 Alphabet
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 
 
 

 Meaning
 ÷
 +
 -
 ×
 
 

 

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

49 + 6 × __**4 ÷ 2**__ - 14

⇒ 49 + __**6 × **____2__ - 14 

⇒ __**49 + 12**__ - 14

⇒ __**61 - 14**__ = 47

Hence, the correct option is "Option 1".
